title: Salmon on Puy lentils with mustard yoghurt
steps: Finely dice the shallot, carrot and celery and sweat in the oil for 3 minutes, add the lentils and stock and simmer for 20–25 minutes.
Fold the spinach into the lentils and season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Salt the salmon and fry it skin side down in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes, turn and cook for 2 more minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard and parsley and serve with the lentils and salmon.
